title: Query Hooks
description: Master useQuery options, pagination, infinite queries, and dependent queries.
longDescription: This module dives deeper into useQuery and its sibling hooks. You will learn every major query option, implement pagination with keepPreviousData, build infinite scroll with useInfiniteQuery, chain dependent queries with the enabled flag, and use placeholderData and initialData for smoother UX.
whatYouLearn: Configure useQuery with staleTime, gcTime, retry, and select
Use placeholderData and initialData for instant UI
Chain dependent queries using the enabled option
